prompt: A guitarist tightens a string and plucks it again, and the note sounds higher. In sound terms, what has increased?

options.text: The speed of sound in the air
The wavelength travelling to the ear only

explanation: Pitch is set by frequency — how many vibrations happen per second. A tighter string vibrates faster, raising the frequency and therefore the pitch.
